text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A, D, and E after gains, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should decide based on my goals and a consistent plan.","I should not hold a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake, or let fear of losses outweigh a balanced assessment of my portfolio.","Prices have moved both up and down, and past changes do not predict what comes next; checking often is not a reason to trade without a clear purpose."]}
